tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The workspace and page ground. Charcoal 900 in dark, bone in light. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, sidebars, cards and the cut-list table on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells and the sheet-layout canvas behind parts.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, list items and buttons: one step up from the surface they sit on. Hover is a surface change only, never a colour, so `signal` always means selected or measured.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only; never the sole carrier of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mean something: inputs, the title-block frame, part outlines. 3.7:1 on `surface`, 3.4:1 on `surface-raised`, 4.0:1 on `surface-sunken`, 3.0:1 on `surface-hover` in dark; 3.5 / 3.7 / 3.1 / 3.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the wordmark and the mono mark. Bone on charcoal, charcoal on bone. Dark: 13.8:1 on `surface`, 12.4:1 on `surface-raised`, 14.8:1 on `surface-sunken`, 11.2:1 on `surface-hover`. Light: 15.1 / 16.2 / 13.7 / 13.8:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, units, captions, placeholder. Dark: 5.7:1 on `surface`, 5.1:1 on `surface-raised`, 6.1:1 on `surface-sunken`, 4.6:1 on `surface-hover`. Light: 5.4 / 5.8 / 4.9 / 5.0:1.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: White oak, the brand colour: the symbol in the app icon and avatar, and nothing in the interface. Never a fill for a model part, a button, a tag or a state. As a graphic it holds 7.2:1 on `surface` in dark and 4.1:1 in light (3.7:1 on light `surface-sunken`); use the mono mark where it would fall under 3:1.

tokens.name: on-wood
tokens.usage: Text or marks laid on a `wood` fill. 7.2:1 dark, 4.7:1 light.

tokens.name: wood-sheet
tokens.usage: Model fill for sheet stock: plywood, MDF, particleboard. Paler and flatter than solid stock; the renderer's lighting, not a second token, shades the edge faces. Told apart from `wood-solid` by lightness: 2.1:1 between them in dark, 2.9:1 in light.

tokens.name: on-wood-sheet
tokens.usage: Part labels on a `wood-sheet` fill. 10.4:1 dark, 7.5:1 light.

tokens.name: wood-solid
tokens.usage: Model fill for solid wood: boards, legs, face frames. Deeper than sheet stock. 5.0:1 on `surface` in dark, 6.7:1 against white text in light.

tokens.name: on-wood-solid
tokens.usage: Part labels on a `wood-solid` fill. 5.0:1 dark, 6.7:1 light.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Chalk-line blue. Every dimension and extension line, measurement chip, the selected part or row, links and the focus ring. The only cool colour in the system. Dark: 6.0:1 on `surface`, 5.4:1 on `surface-raised`, 6.4:1 on `surface-sunken`, 4.8:1 on `surface-hover`. Light: 5.1 / 5.5 / 4.6 / 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill: dimension chips, the primary button label. 6.0:1 dark, 5.7:1 light.

tokens.name: signal-faint
tokens.usage: Selection wash behind a selected part or row; always paired with a `signal` border or outline. `ink` on it: 11.0:1 dark, 13.7:1 light; `signal` text on it (a selected value inside a selected row): 4.8:1 dark, 4.6:1 light.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Not an error: a board drawn without its joint cuts, a part the sheet layout hasn't placed yet, an estimate. Straw yellow, drawn as a dashed outline plus a word, never a solid fill and never colour alone. Lighter than `danger` in dark (9.6:1 vs 6.7:1 on `surface`) and darker in light. Dark: 9.6:1 on `surface`, 8.6:1 on `surface-raised`, 10.3:1 on `surface-sunken`, 7.7:1 on `surface-hover`. Light: 5.5 / 6.0 / 5.0 / 5.1:1.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a `warning` fill, where one is unavoidable (a chip). 9.6:1 dark, 6.3:1 light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: A part that will not fit the sheet, a joint that cannot be cut. Orange, never red, so it never relies on red-versus-green against `signal` blue; drawn as a solid outline plus a word. Dark: 6.7:1 on `surface`, 6.0:1 on `surface-raised`, 7.2:1 on `surface-sunken`, 5.4:1 on `surface-hover`. Light: 5.0 / 5.4 / 4.5 / 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill. 6.7:1 dark, 5.6:1 light.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero and README banner headline only.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Sub-headings, dialog titles, the project name in a title block.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A 1/4-inch back in rabbets, shelves dadoed 3/8 deep.
styles.usage: Running text, descriptions, the parts list.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, title-block captions; uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Grain runs with the long edge

styles.name: dimension
styles.usage: Every measurement in the app. Set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns of dimensions align; fractions stay as typed.

styles.name: dimension-lg
styles.usage: The dimension readout on the model and in a dimension chip; tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: CLI, file formats, exported cut lists in plain text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; the kerf between parts on a sheet layout.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and table cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between rows of controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels; the logo clear space unit.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in documents.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins; banner padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The mark, the wordmark, sheet layouts and title blocks. Square is the default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, table selection.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon container only.

stroke.note: Line weights for drawings, states and the logo.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, sheet outlines, the kerf in the mark at 16 px.

tokens.name: stroke-dimension
tokens.usage: Dimension and extension lines in `signal`.

tokens.name: stroke-part
tokens.usage: Part outlines on a sheet layout; the selected part's outline in `signal`; a `warning` outline, dashed 6/4; a `danger` outline, solid.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: solid `signal`, offset 2px, on every surface. Never a glow.
